title: 9 Best AI Website Builders in 2026: The 7 Rubric Ranking
summary: Nine AI website builders scored across 7 criteria worth 70 points total. Every score checked against the vendor's own pricing pages, docs, and product pages, and manually tested.
body_markdown: Most of them can't, at least not without heavy manual editing afterward. Template-based builders like Wix, Squarespace, and Durable generate a layout that was decided before you typed a brief, so the AI's job is picking the closest template and filling it in, which is why so much AI-built output looks the same. Blink is trained on how high-converting sites are actually structured, so the first draft already has real hierarchy, a proper call to action, and social proof, tailored to the business rather than swapped into a generic shell.
